note: This freezes deterministic selection and weighting before the reproducible source corpus is populated; it is not candidate result data.

selection_protocol.membership: every source record matching a slice selector belongs to that slice
selection_protocol.overlap: allowed and reported; a root is never removed from one matching slice because it matches another
selection_protocol.ordering: ascending raw UTF-8 bytes of id

aggregation.per_slice_metric: median over the slice's measured roots
aggregation.overall_metric: equal-weight median of the six slice medians; for six values use the arithmetic mean of the third and fourth sorted values
